changes: Costs nothing while MUTE MODE is OT, the default: Mute Modes then rests and the Octatrack runs its own mute code untouched.
Choosing OTFX, OTFX-T or DT-T wakes it within one screen refresh; tracks muted before keep the OT cut until unmuted, as before.
Needs Modwerk base 0.8.2 or newer: earlier bases do not accept this version as the owner of the PERSONALIZE rows.
In OTFX-T and DT-T, a muted FM Synth track stays silent too once FM Synth asks Mute Modes which trigs to drop (FM Synth 0.1.4). Until then, use MUTE MODE OT for FM tracks.
Other machines that start their own notes can ask the same way; audio tracks behave as before.
Tested over USB on an MKI: all four modes, solo, a power cycle and removal.
Fixes OTFX sometimes ignoring a mute while timestretched tracks are playing.
Mute Modes no longer writes into memory that the Octatrack's timestretch uses, in any mode, OT included.
Fixes a muted Sidechain KEY track becoming audible after KEY moves to another track: in DT-T its note played out (a looping sample kept going), and OTFX-T and OTFX let a click through.
Fixes a track still muted when MUTE MODE leaves OT becoming audible (in DT-T a looping sample kept going). It now stays cut until it is unmuted.
Tested on an MKI: all four modes, Part and project reload, a power cycle, and beside Sidechain Compressor.
One package now works with or without Sidechain Compressor: a muted track that another module listens to, such as a side-chain KEY, keeps feeding it.
MUTE MODE now survives a power cycle when installed over USB on a Modwerk base.
Needs a newer beta base; the site asks for a base update first.
Known issue: until Sidechain Compressor supports this, a muted Sidechain KEY track goes silent in the soft mute modes.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware, including sound and power-cycle behaviour.
Over USB on a newer Modwerk base, Mute Modes can now be installed together with POLY8.
Needs a newer beta base; older bases refuse this package, and Undo keeps 0.1.0 for them.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware.
Adds OT, OTFX, OTFX-T and DT-T mute behaviours under PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE, keeping the MKII LED BRIGHTNESS row.
Picks a matching variant automatically beside Sidechain Compressor, so a muted KEY track keeps feeding the compressor.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware.
Media only: new artwork showing the four mute behaviours.
